items: Launched on 15th August 2019, aims to provide 55 liters of safe drinking water per person per
day to every rural household through functional tap connections by 2024. Managed by the Ministry
of Jal Shakti, its goal is to ensure no household is left without access to water, with a focus on water
quality monitoring, greywater management, and sustainable water practices.
 Progress: As of 2024, 78% of rural households (15.1 crore) will have access to tap water.
 Notable States: Goa, Gujarat, Punjab, Haryana, Himachal Pradesh, and more have achieved
 Goa became India's first "Har Ghar Jal" state.
